profile.headline: Independent .NET Consultant | Cloud Architecture, API Engineering, DevOps Automation
profile.summary:
Senior Full Stack .NET Developer and Technical Lead with 15+ years of experience delivering scalable, cloud-native software solutions across finance, education, and government. I specialize in enterprise architecture, Agile team leadership, and modern web development using .NET 6–8, Angular, and Azure DevOps.

As Founder of IncrediSoft Solutions, I’ve led the full lifecycle of high-impact SaaS platforms, including Kunverg. My background combines deep technical mastery with strategic thinking, allowing me to transform legacy systems and build future-ready applications.

positions.title: Founder & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and scaled Kunverg, a cloud-native SaaS platform for schools across the Caribbean.
Led end-to-end development with .NET 8, Angular 18, and Azure cloud services.
Designed DevOps automation with Azure Pipelines and service principals for rapid deployments.
Delivered consulting solutions for clients in education and government, aligning tech architecture with business goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET · Databases · CSS · JavaScript · Entity Framework · LINQ · Agile Methodologies · ASP.NET · XML

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer (Contracted to AMADA America Inc.)
positions.description:

Architected microservices to streamline business logic and scale API interactions.
Strengthened team collaboration through Agile practices and velocity coaching.
